Books begin a lifelong cultural journey.

Inma Gonzalez Puy grew up in Barcelona, Spain. As a teenager, she read books that described China. There were few books about China in Spain at the time, but those stories made her curious about a country she had never visited.

In nineteen seventy-nine, she applied to study in Beijing. Reading had given her an imagined picture of China. Living there helped her discover a place that was more complex than that picture. Later, she returned to Beijing to work as a translator and in cultural exchange.

Her work has included bringing Chinese art to audiences in Spain. She helped organize an exhibition in Barcelona that introduced more than thirty Chinese artists. Her experience shows how books, films and exhibitions can help people build lasting connections across different countries and languages.
